The WC Bajau pronoun sets repeated from Table 4.1 Set I enclitics; possessive form Set II independent pronouns em- + Set II oblique pronouns 1st person sg. ku aku m-aku 1st person pl. incl. excl. ti kami kiti kami eng-kiti eng-kami 2nd person sg. nu kau eng-kau 2nd person pl. bi kaam eng-kaam 3rd person sg. ni iyo m-iyo 3rd person pl. gai gai eng-gai Note that the forms for first person plural exclusive kami and third person plural gai are the same for sets I and II. The pronominal forms pattern according to their grammatical status as follows. Subject pronouns are always drawn from Set II, whether the pronoun encodes the single argument of an intransitive clause, the actor of an AV clause, or the undergoer of a UV clause. Conversely, the UV actor is always drawn from Set I. The AV undergoer may be drawn from either Set I or Set II as explained further below.
